```{r setup, include=FALSE}
if (!file.exists("R/bootstrap.R") && file.exists("../R/bootstrap.R")) knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# Aim and data

Study a synthetic seven-day network trace. This experiment does not establish
production performance or causal effects of network interventions.

```{r load}
source("R/bootstrap.R")
trace <- load_trace()
dim(trace)
head(trace)
summary(trace[raw_fields])
```

# Exploratory analysis

```{r explore, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))
plot(trace$timestamp, trace$queue_occupancy_pct, type = "l", col = "darkgreen", ylab = "Queue (%)", xlab = "UTC")
plot(trace$timestamp, trace$rtt_ms, type = "l", col = "steelblue", ylab = "RTT (ms)", xlab = "UTC")
```

# Backward-looking features and future labels

```{r features}
features <- extract_features(trace)
stopifnot(ncol(features) == 29)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(features[1:100, ], extract_features(trace[1:100, ]))))
targets <- future_targets(trace, 15)
head(targets)
tail(targets, 16) # Future targets beyond the trace remain NA.
```

# Chronological train, calibration and test folds

```{r splits}
folds <- temporal_split(nrow(trace))
data.frame(fold = names(folds), first = sapply(folds, min), last = sapply(folds, max), samples = lengths(folds))
stopifnot(max(folds$train) + 30 < min(folds$calibration))
stopifnot(max(folds$calibration) + 30 < min(folds$test))
```

# Train probability and regression forests

```{r train}
system <- train_system(trace)
save_system(system)
system$health$evaluation_metrics
```

# Calibration, baselines and drift

```{r evaluate}
system$health$baseline_comparison
system$health$drift_monitoring
curve <- system$health$calibration_curve
plot(sapply(curve, `[[`, "mean_predicted_probability"), sapply(curve, `[[`, "fraction_positive"),
     xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), pch = 19, xlab = "Predicted probability", ylab = "Observed frequency")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2)
```

# Multi-horizon forecast and current anomaly

```{r forecast}
service <- new_service(system, trace)
event <- step_stream(service, "jump-incident")
event$prediction
```

# Approximate Shapley explanation

```{r explain}
sample <- latest_features(window_history(service$windows))
explanation <- explain_features(system, sample)
attributions <- do.call(rbind, lapply(explanation$all_attributions, as.data.frame))
head(attributions, 10)
stopifnot(abs(explanation$base_value + sum(attributions$shap_value) - explanation$predicted_risk) < 1e-8)
```

These approximate contributions explain raw forest probability, not calibrated
probability. Correlated features complicate causal interpretation.

# What-if mitigation

```{r simulate}
simulate_scenario(service, list()) # No action preserves baseline.
simulate_scenario(service, list(reroute_traffic_pct = 25, enable_priority_queuing = TRUE))
```

# Conclusions to write in your lab record

Compare the forest with persistence. Report Brier score, recall, false positives,
RTT error and measured interval coverage. Explain limitations of synthetic traffic,
distribution shift, correlated features and heuristic intervention transformations.
Record package versions for reproducibility.

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
